en.name: AeroSwift
en.subtitle: Flight and airport board
en.short_description: Track a flight, read an airport board, and save the ones you fly.
en.description:
AeroSwift is a flight tracker with one job: tell you where an aircraft is and when it is going to land, without an account and without noise.

WHAT IT DOES
• Search a flight by callsign and open a detail view with altitude, aircraft, route, and scheduled versus actual times.
• Open any airport's board and read its arrivals and departures over a window you choose.
• Save the flights you follow so they are one tap away next time.
• A route diagram and a status chip summarise the leg at a glance.

ABOUT THE DATA
AeroSwift ships with an offline sample data set so the app is fully navigable the moment you install it. Switch to live data from the OpenSky Network in Settings — the endpoints AeroSwift uses need no key and no sign-up. A banner in the app always tells you which source you are looking at, so you are never guessing whether a number is real.

NO ACCOUNT
There is no login, no profile, and nothing to subscribe to. Saved flights and your data-source choice stay on the device.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
AeroSwift is a flight tracker with one job: tell you where an aircraft is and when it is going to land, without an account and without noise.

Intended audience:
Flight and airport board

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. Every feature is reachable from the first screen after launch.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- HTTPS requests to the app's own endpoints

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (locale 1, locale 10, locale 11, locale 12, locale 2, locale 3, locale 4, locale 5, locale 6, locale 7, locale 8, locale 9). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.
